issues.description: Two proof helpers that construct tracked resources use the `lemma_` prefix instead of the ownership-role prefix `tracked_`.
issues.rationale: Both functions return a tracked resource and their bodies construct and return tracked values, so `name-proof-roles` requires the `tracked_` prefix rather than `lemma_`, which is reserved for reusable proved facts. Review comments 3557696368 and 3557698288 request that correction, and the final PR head renames them to `tracked_frame_entry_new` and `tracked_segment_entry_new`.

issues.description: Three reusable proof facts are missing the required `lemma_` prefix.
issues.rationale: Each function is a `proof fn` whose contract establishes a reusable fact for callers and none is a tracked-resource constructor. The `name-proof-roles` rule therefore requires a `lemma_` prefix. Review comments 3557701673, 3557703902, and 3557707042 identify the same naming root cause; the final head adds `lemma_` to all three names.

issues.description: Proof work rewrites the executable `NR_LEVELS()` method instead of preserving its original direct return shape.
issues.rationale: The selected head changes the executable method from a direct `C::C::NR_LEVELS()` return into a named result, local variable, proof block, and final return. The `preserve-exec-code` rule requires proof additions to avoid rewriting executable Rust unless necessary and to keep any unavoidable change minimal. Review comment 3557714902 calls the rewrite surprising, the author reply 3563072027 explicitly says it will be changed back, and the final approved head restores the direct executable call while keeping only the necessary proof assertion.
issues.verification: source-only; historical Verus not executed. Compared the base, fixed historical review head, author reply, and final approved head, confirming that the executable rewrite was reverted.
